channel.title: Worcester Business Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Worcester Business Journal (wbjournal.com)

item.title: Italian restaurant to replace Uno’s at The Shops at Blackstone Valley
item.description: The Shops at Blackstone Valley has a new tenant.

item.title: Campbell suing Holden, eight other towns over MBTA housing law compliance
item.description: Campbell pledged recently to take action by the end of this week if communities did not come into compliance.

item.title: 🔒 Workers Credit Union opens new Leominster branch, appoints new growth-focused executive
item.description: WCU’s new branch at 866 Merriam Ave. offers both personal and business banking.

item.title: WinnCompanies completes 93-unit apartment complex in Shrewsbury
item.description: The site was built to passive house standard, featuring high-efficiency HVAC systems and a 150-kilowatt rooftop solar array.

item.title: Northborough dental device company acquires Washington developer
item.description: Northborough-based dental device manufacturer Solmetex has expanded its product portfolio with the acquisition of ReLeaf, a fellow dental device developer out of Washington state.

item.title: WooSox ownership adding roof to left field event space for 2026 season
item.description: The new roof for the space, often used for employee outings and corporate events, will help shield patrons from rain and heat.

item.title: 🔒 Fitchburg Fiber Co. launches new cooperative, plans local mobile service
item.description: Internet service provider Fitchburg Fiber Co. has established a new cooperative to create a community-owned local fiber infrastructure, set to launch a mobile phone service in the spring.

item.title: Northborough inventor of one of Time’s Best Inventions of 2025 acquires Irish firm
item.description: Ozlo, a Northborough-based producer of noise-masking earbuds for sleep, is expanding its work into neuroscience research and development with the acquisition of Segotia, a neuro-audio engineering company out of Ireland.

item.title: Fitchburg former bank building to be converted into 35 apartments
item.description: The site overlooks the North Nashua River and the Water Street Bridge, which is being rebuilt.

item.title: 🔒 Harvard Bioscience to shutter Holliston manufacturing facility
item.description: The closure is part of the company’s overall strategic consolidation plan, known as Project Viking, which will cost the company about $4 million in restructuring expenses.
